title: malva punctata
intro: Malva punctata, commonly known as the spotted mallow or prickly mallow, is a plant species in the family Malvaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include treating skin conditions, such as eczema and dermatitis, as well as having anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Malva punctata include soothing and calming irritated skin, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
